component.name: Ginrose Studio
component.summary: Run the official macOS Roblox Studio on Linux

description.p: Ginrose Studio runs the official macOS Roblox Studio on Linux through Rosemary, a macOS compatibility layer. It downloads Studio straight from Roblox, keeps it up to date, opens "Edit in Studio" links from the website and brings Studio's browser login back to it.
What runs is up to you: any Rosemary build, any FastFlag, any environment variable and extra launch arguments. Repairing Studio and the prefix is one click away when something goes wrong.
